name: Households with a broadband subscription
source: U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts, Monterey County, California; 2020–2024 ACS period
notes: QuickFacts reports 93.8% of households with a broadband subscription for 2020–2024. Census QuickFacts was opened directly; evidence capture was attempted in the sandbox and with the approved capture helper, but Census returned HTTP 403 and no snapshot was saved. Local tier-1 searches did not expose a newer countywide value. The ACS period begins in 2020, so it is not a single-year observation. This is a Monterey County proxy permitted by portrait scale policy; it is not a measurement for Carmel-by-the-Sea city limits. Tier 1 local searches found no city/county local series; Tier 2 QuickFacts was directly opened, but the evidence capture was blocked by Census HTTP 403; archive remains empty.
